x: Bobby Nelson fought well to hold off Chris Ryan in the one lap event and Roger Keys turned the tables on John Bicourt with a well judged run in the half mile.

Other juniors who have had a good season are John Mitchell,John Martin, Phil Smith,Bob Nelson,Dave Nicklin and Adrian Major. Many others who are under the guidance of Tom Carter are improving fast and the seniors will surely benefit in the very near future.

Bob Nelson ran his best ever 440y in windy conditions which slowed down his opposition to well below their best. At the halfway mark he had all but caught Woodland (Hercules) who was in the lane outside him and his time of 52.2 promises good things to come in better conditions.
By the time the final came around he was practically dead on his feet but his turn of speed around the final bend was still too much for Bob Nelson and Alan Mead, so he gained himself a second 'pot'.

Twentynine years ago at Crystal Palace, and Jim Vivian, Chris Martin, Robert Nelson and Dave Mitchell pose for the camera of Ed. Lacey after placing 6th in the final of the A.A.A. 4 x 220yds relay Championship in 1:31.9.
